topic.title: Export and Import the Project History
topic.shortdesc: Back up all the conversations of a project in an archive, move them to another computer, or add the conversations from an archive to the history of a project.

body.p: Besides exporting or importing a single conversation, you can export the entire chat history of the current project to a ZIP archive and import such an archive into the history of a project. This allows you to back up your conversations, move them to another computer, or share them with a colleague.

The actions are available in the History drop-down menu of the AI Positron view. When the assistant is displayed in a separate window, they are available in the menu of the History button (the three vertical dots button) at the top of the history panel beside the chat. The actions are not available while the AI is processing a request or while another history operation is running. The Export project history action is available only when the history contains conversations.

section.title: Export the Project History

ol.li: In the History menu, select Export project history.
In the file chooser, select the name and location of the ZIP archive.

section.p: The conversations are written to the archive in the background. If the operation takes a while, a progress dialog is displayed, where you can cancel it. Canceling does not create the archive. When the export ends, a message tells you how many conversations were exported and where the archive was saved. If some conversations could not be read, the message tells you how many of the total could not be exported.
section.note: The conversations are kept encrypted in the history of the project, but they are saved in the archive without encryption, as JSON files, so that they can be read on another computer. Store the archive in a location that you trust.

section.title: Import the Project History

ol.li: In the History menu, select Import project history.
In the file chooser, select the ZIP archive that contains the conversations.

section.p: The conversations are read from the archive in the background. If the operation takes a while, a progress dialog is displayed, where you can cancel it. The imported conversations are added to the ones already in the history. You can continue them like any other conversation. The import never removes or replaces the existing conversations.

Conversations that are already in the history are skipped, so importing an archive into the project from which it was exported does not add anything. When the import ends, a message tells you how many conversations were imported and how many were skipped. If all the conversations of the archive are already in the history, the message tells you that nothing was imported. If you cancel the import, the conversations imported until then are kept, and the message tells you how many they are.
The entries of the archive that are not valid conversations are skipped. An error message is displayed if the archive cannot be opened or if it does not contain any conversation that can be imported.
